subject: Late-stage capacity gate: pod-level node mapping & surge contingency for BlueCrest
messages:
From: Amina Solis <amina@bluecrest.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@bluecrest.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Initial capacity check ahead of SOW

Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're moving very quickly on our infra decision and the procurement team has asked us for a short capacity plan tied to the committed SLA window. We're evaluating a production rollout that will need a steady baseline for the first 6 months with predictable burst capacity for training-style replays.

High level ask: can Redwood confirm node-level availability for a Dedicated pool sized roughly for 40–50 M-token/day at 8k context (our evals so far), with 24/7 low-latency slices for inference and a burst lane for heavy batch replay jobs? We need an inventory snapshot and your recommended soft-hold process to avoid losing those nodes while finalizing contract terms.

We've attached a simple usage projection (bluecrest_node_map_v2.xlsx). Can you route this to capacity ops and give us your recommended safety window and any lead time constraints?

— Amina
Director, Platform Engineering
BlueCrest AI

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Amina Solis <amina@bluecrest.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial capacity check ahead of SOW

Amina —

Thanks for the projection — circulated to Capacity and Ops. Quick next steps from our side:
- Karthik will run a pod-level fit (node mapping) against current US Dedicated pools and return a feasible allocation and a recommended "soft-hold" token quantity.
- Monica will add an ops note about minimum commitment windows to avoid preemption during your planned ramp.
- Ben and I will align on the commercial treatment of the soft-hold (whether it counts toward a commitment or as a refundable escrow).

Can you confirm the dates for the ramp (pilot → GA)? That feeds lead time.

Jordan Blake
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Initial capacity check ahead of SOW

All —

I've completed a first-pass node mapping using Amina's sheet. Summary:
- Baseline steady-state: ~6 dedicated T4s (or 2x A10s equivalent) plus 2 smaller nodes reserved for low-latency control-plane services.
- Burst lane: recommend reserving 3 additional larger nodes (A40-class or equivalent) in a soft-hold for replay jobs. Those can be autoscaled but must be fenced off under a node token to avoid transient allocation to other customers.
- Suggested safety window: 30 days soft-hold with a 14-day rolling notice to release. For guaranteed hold beyond 30 days we need a signed commitment or a refundable credit to justify capacity assignment.
- Quantization/throughput note: if BlueCrest moves to int8 quantization for the main model shard, compute needs drop ~25% which could change node counts; we'll include that optional profile in the proposal.

I've attached the detailed mapping (bluecrest_node_map_v2.xlsx) and a short capacity sketch (RD-5421_capacity_proposal_v1.pdf). Ops impact: Monica, please add any constraints about multi-tenant pools and preemption behavior.

- Karthik
Sr. Capacity Planner, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Initial capacity check ahead of SOW

Team —

Operational constraints to call out for BlueCrest:
- Lead time for A40-class guaranteed reservations: 10 business days if nodes are available in the region; otherwise 3–4 weeks for provisioning/flex rearrangement.
- Soft-hold mechanism: we can create a "reservation token" tied to the deal_id (RD-5421) that blocks the nodes from pre-allocation but does not consume billing unless converted. Token lifecycle: issue token -> 30-day hold -> auto-release unless escrow/commitment applied.
- Fallback policy: if a hard incident occurs (hardware outage), we will transparently failover to compatible node classes in a different AZ and expose delta performance metrics. That will require a brief maintenance window for KV cache warmup; estimate 6–12 minutes per shard.
- Security/compliance: if BlueCrest requires VPC peering for Dedicated, lead time may increase by 5 business days for networking and KMS setup.

Recommend we propose: 30-day soft-hold + optional refundable credit to extend to 90 days. Ben/Jordan — how do we want to present the commercial terms for refundable escrow vs. pre-paid commitment?

— Monica
Head of Capacity Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Amina Solis <amina@bluecrest.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 16:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial capacity check ahead of SOW (proposal & next steps)

Amina / Ravi —

Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround. Based on the node map and ops guidance, here's what we can offer:

1) Soft-hold (30 days) on the mapped pod: no charge, reservation token issued immediately on mutual confirmation.
2) Escrow option to extend hold to 90 days: refundable credit equal to 20% of estimated 3-month committed spend (applies only if no final commitment executed).
3) Guaranteed reservation (60/12 month commit): normal commitment pricing and SLA; leads to fixed node assignment and faster AZ-level failover.

Please confirm which path you'd prefer. Also propose a short sync on Friday to walk the internal node map and ensure the replay schedule fits the burst lane. Jordan — can you schedule a 30-min call and include a permissions link to the drive file?

Amina — happy to loop legal on a short simple reservation MOU if you want something to attach to procurement.

Best,
Ben Carter
Revenue Lead, Redwood Inference

On Fri, Aug 6, 2026 at 08:00 AM Amina replied: "Thanks — let's take the 30-day soft-hold and the escrow option while we finalize procurement. Friday sync works; we'll take the call and share our procurement calendar." (forwarded inline)
